  school_table_district: NULL
  school_table_county: NULL
  boundary_type: NULL
  daycare_table: NULL
  case_table: NULL
  table_type: NULL
  county: NULL
  district: NULL
  gt_sort_by: NULL
  nonreporting_note: NULL
  redacted_childcares_note: NULL
  coverage_bands: NULL
  case_age_groups: NULL
---

```{css, echo=FALSE}
h1 {
  text-align: center;
}
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
if (params$table_type == "School Vaccine Coverage" && params$boundary_type == "district") {
  table_to_use <- params$school_table_district
} else {
  table_to_use <- switch(params$table_type,
    "School Vaccine Coverage" = params$school_table_county,
    "Child Care Vaccine Coverage" = params$daycare_table,
    "Historical Measles Cases" = params$case_table
  )
}

filtered_data <- if (params$table_type == "Historical Measles Cases" && params$county == "Statewide") {
  table_to_use %>%
    dplyr::group_by(year, age_group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_cases = sum(n_cases, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(county = "Statewide")
} else if (params$table_type == "School Vaccine Coverage" && params$boundary_type == "district") {
  table_to_use %>%
    dplyr::filter(district == params$district)
} else {
  table_to_use %>%
    dplyr::filter(county == params$county)
}
```

```{r, fig.height = 350 / 96, fig.width= 850 / 96}
# --- Recreate Epi Curve Plot ---

if (params$table_type == "Historical Measles Cases") {
  all_years <- sort(unique(params$case_table$year))
  min_year <- min(all_years, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_year <- max(all_years, na.rm = TRUE)

  county_years <- data.frame(year = seq(min_year, max_year, by = 1))
  base_df <- params$case_table

  county_cases <- if (params$county == "Statewide") {
    base_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(cases = sum(n_cases, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::right_join(county_years, by = "year") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(cases = tidyr::replace_na(cases, 0L))
  } else {
    base_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(county == params$county) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(cases = sum(n_cases, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::right_join(county_years, by = "year") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(cases = tidyr::replace_na(cases, 0L))
  }
  ggplot2::ggplot(county_cases, ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = cases)) +
    # --- Navy bars with soft edges ---
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.75, fill = "#1E3A66") +
    # --- Yellow labels for readability ---
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      ggplot2::aes(label = ifelse(cases > 0, cases, "")),
      vjust = -0.5, size = 4.5, color = "black", fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Year",
      y = "Number of Cases",
      title = paste0(
        "Measles Cases by Year: ",
        ifelse(params$county == "Statewide", "", "County of "),
        params$county
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(min_year, max_year, 1),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.3)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8),
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", color = "#1E3A66"),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", color = "#1E3A66"),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", color = "#1E3A66"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#1E3A66"),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )
}
```


```{r}
# --- Recreate GT Table for Historical ---

# No rows (e.g. a county with no recorded cases): show a message instead of
# a table. This has to be one if/else with the cases table below: in an R
# Markdown chunk, return() doesn't skip the code that follows it.
if (nrow(filtered_data) == 0) {
  gt::gt(data.frame(
    Message = if (params$table_type == "Historical Measles Cases") {
      "No historical cases for selected county"
    } else {
      "No data for selected location"
    }
  ))
} else if (params$table_type == "Historical Measles Cases") {
  # Same table as the Summary tab (render_cases_gt(), table_measles_functions.R)
  render_cases_gt(filtered_data, params$county,
                  case_age_groups(params$case_age_groups, params$case_table$age_group))
}
```

```{r}
# === Schools / Daycares view ===
# Skipped when there are no rows; the chunk above shows a message instead.
if (nrow(filtered_data) > 0 && params$table_type %in% c(
  "School Vaccine Coverage",
  "Child Care Vaccine Coverage"
)) {
  sort_col <- if (!is.null(params$gt_sort_by) &&
    params$table_type %in% c(
      "School Vaccine Coverage",
      "Child Care Vaccine Coverage"
    )) {
    params$gt_sort_by
  } else {
    "full_vax_pct"
  }

  # Guard: if sort_col not present, fall back
  if (!sort_col %in% names(filtered_data)) sort_col <- "full_vax_pct"

  # --- Sorting logic ---

  if (params$table_type == "Child Care Vaccine Coverage" || (params$table_type == "School Vaccine Coverage" && params$boundary_type == "county")) {
    if (sort_col %in% c("name", "county")) {
      # Case-insensitive alphabetical sort
      sorted_data <- filtered_data %>%
        dplyr::arrange(tolower(.data[[sort_col]]))
    } else {
      # Numeric sorts: high → low
      sorted_data <- filtered_data %>%
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data[[sort_col]]))
    }
  } else {
    if (sort_col %in% c("name", "district")) {
      # Case-insensitive alphabetical sort
      sorted_data <- filtered_data %>%
        dplyr::arrange(tolower(.data[[sort_col]]))
    } else {
      # Numeric sorts: high → low
      sorted_data <- filtered_data %>%
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data[[sort_col]]))
    }
  }

  # --- Build the gt table ---

  if (params$table_type == "Child Care Vaccine Coverage" || (params$table_type == "School Vaccine Coverage" && params$boundary_type == "county")) {
    table_gt <- sorted_data %>%
      gt::gt() %>%
      gt::tab_header(
        title = paste(params$table_type, "Vaccination Summary:", params$county)
      ) %>%
      # Keep the ">" sign in the displayed values
      gt::fmt(
        columns = full_vax_pct,
        fns = function(x) sorted_data$full_vax_pct_chr
      ) %>%
      # Apply custom color logic
      gt::data_color(
        columns = full_vax_pct,
        colors = function(x) mmr_colors(x, sorted_data$full_vax_pct_chr, coverage_bands(params$coverage_bands))
      ) %>%
      gt::cols_hide(columns = full_vax_pct_chr)
  } else if (params$table_type == "School Vaccine Coverage" && params$boundary_type == "district") {
    table_gt <- sorted_data %>%
      gt::gt() %>%
      gt::tab_header(
        title = paste(params$table_type, "Vaccination Summary:", params$district)
      ) %>%
      # Keep the ">" sign in the displayed values
      gt::fmt(
        columns = full_vax_pct,
        fns = function(x) sorted_data$full_vax_pct_chr
      ) %>%
      # Apply custom color logic
      gt::data_color(
        columns = full_vax_pct,
        fn = function(x) mmr_colors(x, sorted_data$full_vax_pct_chr, coverage_bands(params$coverage_bands))
      ) %>%
      gt::cols_hide(columns = full_vax_pct_chr)
  }

  if (params$table_type == "School Vaccine Coverage") {
    if (params$boundary_type == "county") {
      table_gt <- table_gt %>%
        gt::cols_label(
          county           = "County",
          name             = "School Name",
          type             = "School Type",
          full_vax_pct     = "MMR %",
          total_enrollment = "Enrollment"
        )
    } else {
      table_gt <- table_gt %>%
        gt::cols_label(
          district         = "School District",
          name             = "School Name",
          type             = "School Type",
          full_vax_pct     = "MMR %",
          total_enrollment = "Enrollment"
        )
    }
    # Source note from the dashboard settings (notes$nonreporting_table)
    if (!is.null(params$nonreporting_note)) {
      table_gt <- table_gt %>%
        gt::tab_source_note(source_note = params$nonreporting_note)
    }
  } else if (params$table_type == "Child Care Vaccine Coverage") {
    table_gt <- table_gt %>%
      gt::fmt(
        columns = full_vax_pct,
        fns = function(x) {
          ifelse(is.na(sorted_data$full_vax_pct_chr),
            "Data redacted",
            sorted_data$full_vax_pct_chr
          )
        }
      ) %>%
      gt::cols_hide(columns = c(is_blurred)) %>%
      gt::cols_label(
        county           = "County",
        name             = "Child Care Name",
        full_vax_pct     = "MMR %",
        total_enrollment = "MMR Eligible"
      )
    # Source note from the dashboard settings (notes$redacted_childcares)
    if (!is.null(params$redacted_childcares_note)) {
      table_gt <- table_gt %>%
        gt::tab_source_note(source_note = params$redacted_childcares_note)
    }
  }
  table_gt
}
```
